name: theme-registry
body: Theme registry: project themes (one directory per theme under a library layer's `themes/<name>/`) mapping to their `theme.css` and files, registered by the template-library-loader; lookup by deck config, omitted theme resolves to `default`; an unknown name is an error listing project themes. Themes come solely from the resolved library layers (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets). A theme's `theme.css` — and every stylesheet it imports — may carry reserved `media:` references into its layer's shared `media/` tree and reserved `theme:<name>/` references into another theme's files, plus references relative to its own location (validated by the loader, theme-media-references); the theme registry serves the raw theme files and the HTTP server rewrites those references to served URLs at serve time.
